d:
Maharashtr ke ahilyangar ki shabnam shekh intarneshnal resling koch hain. lekin kushti ke khel men kariyar banana unke lie aasan nahin tha. shabnam ka kahna hai ki muslim samuday se hone ke nate unke oopar zyada dabav tha. 2010 men pahla vimens kesri taital jitne vali shabnam ne resling men piechdi ki hai. ye hai shabnam shekh ki kahani, jo kaee larkiyon ko prerna deti hai.
Riport aur shut: shahid shekh
